ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, and commercial counterparties must be screened against the Egyptian Terrorist and Money Laundering Lists maintained by the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit and Central Bank of Egypt, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the US OFAC SDN List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the UK HM Treasury sanctions list. Enhanced CDD is mandatory for any person identified as a politically exposed person (PEP) or connected to a PEP; such relationships require senior management approval in writing, ongoing transaction monitoring, and refresher screening at least every six months or upon any trigger event under Article 5 of Law No. 80 of 2002.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Investment Registry / Company Name Clearance Portal (https://www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed commercial name must be submitted in Arabic characters. A Latin-script transliteration may be registered as a secondary name or trade name. The name may not consist solely of numerals, may not replicate a foreign word inconsistently with Arabic phonetics, and any foreign brand name must be Arabicized in a manner approved by the Commercial Registry. The Arabic name must comply with the rules of the Egyptian Commercial Registry under Law No. 34 of 1970 concerning the Commercial Register and Ministerial Decree No. 127 of 2019.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If GAFI rejects the proposed name, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal to GAFI's Registration and Appeals Committee within 15 days of electronic notification, attaching alternative names and a response to the stated rejection basis. GAFI must resolve the appeal within 30 days. If the appeal is denied or deemed unduly delayed, the applicant may institute a challenge before the Cairo Administrative Court of the Council of State within 60 days from the final rejection decision, with a copy served on GAFI and the Minister of Trade and Industry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office cannot serve as the statutory registered office for a wholesale alcoholic beverage distribution company under Egyptian law. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physically occupied address in Egypt for service of process and tax registration. A serviced office or business center may be accepted only if it provides a physical meeting room and a written lease agreement, but the entity must also hold a valid licensed warehouse or cold-chain storage facility matching the statutory business license for ISIC 4632. The registered legal address must be stated in the Memorandum of Association and notified to GAFI, the Tax Authority, and the Commercial Registry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 70% likelihood of unannounced GAFI, Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, or Egyptian Tax Authority inspection during the first six months of active operation, driven by alcohol licensing sensitivity, cold-chain logistics, and post-incorporation substance verification requirements.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, Articles 1-14 (Limited Liability Companies), as amended by Laws No. 4 of 2009, No. 94 of 2005, and No. 149 of 2019; read together with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (Decree No. 2310 of 2017) for one-stop-shop incorporation via GAFI.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop (OSS), Corporate Contracts and Commercial Registry coordination desks, Cairo and Governorate branches.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association (Aqd Taasis al-Sharika wa Nizamuha al-Asasi) authenticated by GAFI legal office and the Notary Public (Tawthiq).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for LLCs; the capital amount is fixed freely in the Articles of Association. The subscribed capital must be deposited in an Egyptian bank account and evidenced by a bank capital deposit certificate (Shihadat Iidat) before Commercial Registry filing; GAFI model articles commonly adopt EGP 50,000 minimum.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: It is RESOLVED by the subscribing founders of [Company Name] LLC: 1. Share Subscription: The issued capital of EGP 2,000,000, divided into 200,000 equal ordinary shares, is hereby fully subscribed and allotted per the signed subscription schedule. 2. Registered Office: The registered office is fixed at 14 Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road, Smart Village, Giza Governorate, Egypt, which shall be the statutory address. 3. Board of Managers: [Name] and [Name] are appointed Managers; [Name] is appointed Managing Manager. 4. Signatory Powers: All banking and contractual instruments require the joint signatures of the Managing Manager and any one other Manager. 5. Delegation: The Managing Manager is authorized to complete all governmental registrations, tax filings, and licensing applications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name reservation and one-stop-shop incorporation application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) - electronic portal www.gafi.gov.eg / GAFI Central Department, Cairo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application through the GAFI OSS portal selecting 'LLC incorporation', provision two to three Arabic name options, upload the draft Articles of Association, and pay the statutory e-filing fee. GAFI screens the draft for conformity with Companies Law 159/1981 and Investment Law 72/2017 before issuance of the name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft Arabic/English Memorandum and Articles of Association
Copy of national ID or passport of each founding shareholder and manager
Statement of capital subscription and share allocation
Declaration of general assembly formation and managers
Feedback on alcoholic beverage regulated activity (Law 63 of 1976 acknowledgment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Remedy identified deficiencies in the GAFI OSS review queue and resubmit within 15 business days; if the corporate name is rejected, submit alternative names without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and legal authentication of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Legal Office and Notary Public (Tawthiq), GAFI Governorate branch of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders appear physically or through notarized attorneys-in-fact before the GAFI legal officer to authenticate signatures on the Articles of Association. The authenticated contract is stamped by the Notary Public and returned to the applicant for use in bank account opening and commercial registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association incorporating GAFI legal comments
Identity documents of all founders and appointed managers
Power of attorney if any founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legal officer issues a correction memorandum, amend the articles accordingly and refile within the requested period; first resubmission does not attract additional GAFI legal fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account opening and capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr) - Corporate Banking Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the LLC's corporate current account using the GAFI-authenticated Articles and corporate identification, deposit the subscribed capital, and obtain the bank capital deposit certificate. This certificate evidences paid-up capital for the Commercial Registry and, in practice, the clearance of the controlled-activity entity.
required_dossiers: Board of Managers (founders' assembly) resolution on signatories
KYC/AML declarations and beneficial ownership statement
Lease contract or ownership deed of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence because of the alcohol-related activity, supplement the file with the GAFI scope confirmation and the early-stage license application; any capital shortfall is cured before issuance of the deposit certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registry filing and trade license registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade - GAFI OSS commercial registration counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the GAFI-authenticated Articles, bank capital deposit certificate, and registered-office evidence with the Commercial Registry. Pay the registration, repository, and publication charges to receive the physical/electronic Commercial Registration Certificate stating the LLC's ISIC 4632 activity (wholesale and cold-chain distribution of craft beer) and its authorized managers.
required_dossiers: Certified founders' assembly resolution appointing managers
Certificate of registered office address (lease or title deed)
Managers' criminal record certificates and national IDs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the activity classification, file a supplementary activity declaration specifying ISIC 4632 wholesale cold-chain distribution with a covering letter; administrative objections are heard by the Commercial Registry Director within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax card, VAT, and payroll registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance - Companies Registration Unit at the OSS or competent local tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the tax registration file, obtain the corporate tax card (Bataga Dhareebiya), and enroll for VAT (Law 67 of 2016) and stamp-tax obligations. The ETA will reflect ISIC 4632 and the cold-chain distribution activity, enabling lawful invoicing, imports, and export operations.
required_dossiers: Board resolution designating the tax representative
Predicted annual turnover and activity declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office queries excise or alcohol trade specifics, present the Commercial Registry activity certificate and the NFSA/industrial license pipeline letter; objections must be lodged with the local head of the tax office within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - competent Governorate branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as an employer within 14 days of commercial registration, enroll the Managing Manager and staff, and place the payroll on the NOSI contribution module under Law No. 148 of 2019. Monthly contribution declarations commence from the registration date.
required_dossiers: List of managers, employees and employment contracts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late enrollment penalties are settled by applying for NOSI social reconciliation and installment plans; the supervisor office issues a compliance certificate upon full regularization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Egyptian Official Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Al-Waqa'i Al-Misriyya (Official Gazette) - publication desk coordinated through GAFI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation notice containing the company name, GAFI file number, capital amount, registered office, and managers. A copy of the Gazette page is collected and added to the corporate file, completing third-party effectiveness of the incorporation vis-a-vis the public.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed, an acceleration request is submitted to the Gazette directorate; typographical errors in the published notice are cured by a corrective notice at nominal cost.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Authority for Industrial Development (IDA), Ministry of Trade and Industry - Industrial Licensing Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operation License (Rukhsat Al-Tashghil Al-Sina'i) under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 for the microbrewery line; Food and Beverage Establishment Registration Certificate from the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) under Law No. 1 of 2017; special alcoholic-beverage sales/export permit from the General Department of Alcoholic Beverages Licensing, Ministry of Interior under Law No. 63 of 1976 for wholesale distribution and export.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment - Environmental Impact Assessment Department and licensed environmental consultants (offices)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Impact Screening (initial environmental examination) applicable to beverage manufacturing, bottling, and cold-storage logistics facilities; the screening report is submitted with the IDA industrial operation license application and the EEAA issues a conditional environmental certification.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Brewery wastewater discharge to municipal sewer must comply with Law No. 48 of 1982 executive standards: pH 6-9, BOD5 <= 60 mg/L, COD <= 100 mg/L, TSS <= 50 mg/L, oils and grease <= 10 mg/L, total residual chlorine <= 1 mg/L. Fermentation and cleaning VOC emissions are captured and treated to national ambient air quality limits of Law No. 4 of 1994 and Executive Regulations Decree No. 338 of 1995. Spent grains, spent yeast, and keg-washing effluents are handled under an approved waste-management contract; hazardous waste manifests are issued for caustic and CIP chemicals.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Clearance Certificate (firefighting, evacuation, and alarm plans) issued by the General Administration of Civil Defense of the Ministry of Interior before operation; structural load inspection certificate for the cold-store mezzanine and racking system from an accredited engineering office; Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) committee registration and workplace clearance with the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, including ammonia/CO2 leak detection and personal protective equipment protocols for keg line and cold-room operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Arab Republic of Egypt; official national portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; electronic-invoice and e-receipt platform operated by the ETA with open REST/XML APIs under the same portal. The ETA has exclusive competence over corporate income tax, VAT, stamp duty, payroll tax, electronic invoicing, and export VAT refunds for the EG_LLC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Egyptian LLC: Step 1 — incorporate the LLC in the Commercial Registry and obtain the commercial register extract; an Egyptian LLC may be 100% foreign-owned and has no statutory minimum paid-in capital. Step 2 — within 30 days of commencing activity, apply at the competent ETA office or through the ETA e-portal for a unified Tax Card, which issues the single Tax Identification Number covering corporate income tax, VAT, payroll tax, and stamp duties under Tax Procedure Law No. 88/2023. Step 3 — file mandatory VAT registration because annual taxable turnover exceeds the EGP 500,000 threshold; a non-resident person supplying taxable goods or services into Egypt must appoint an ETA-accredited tax representative, while a resident Egyptian LLC with non-resident shareholders is itself the taxpayer and must maintain a local address and a responsible compliance officer. Step 4 — onboard to the ETA e-invoicing API by obtaining API credentials and a digital signing certificate and by completing sandbox testing before issuing live invoices. Step 5 — secure the statutory alcohol wholesale/distribution license required for beer distribution, register the license particulars with the ETA, and activate the customs ASYCUDA World export clearance profile for export consignments.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: an Egyptian LLC is an opaque resident juridical person. It is taxed as a separate taxpayer on worldwide income under Income Tax Law No. 30/2023; no pass-through or partner-level attribution of profit applies, and members are not taxed on undistributed LLC income. Non-resident counterparties are taxed only on Egyptian-source income. For indirect tax, the LLC is the VAT taxable person and is solely responsible for collecting output VAT and claiming input VAT credit.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law provides no check-the-box election and no hybrid-mismatch election; an Egyptian LLC cannot elect fiscal transparency. Available statutory elections include: (i) consolidated corporate income tax filing where a parent owns at least 95% of an Egyptian subsidiary; (ii) voluntary VAT registration for persons below the EGP 500,000 threshold; (iii) election of the accounting period aligned with the Egyptian fiscal year; and (iv) administrative election between simplified deemed-profit accounting and actual audited accounting for eligible small taxpayers. A VAT group election, partnership pass-through election, and OECD Pillar Two or GLoBE elections are not available in Egypt.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended, implemented through Executive Regulation issued under Ministry of Finance Decree No. 66/2017. The VAT regime is supplemented by selective consumption duties and excises on alcoholic beverages administered by the ETA and customs at factory gate or import release; such duties are additional to, and do not displace, VAT on the beer supply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 aggregate annual value of taxable supplies of goods and services; registration is compulsory above this threshold under Law No. 67 of 2016. Beer exporters and alcohol wholesalers are in practice required to register as a condition of exercising licensed activity, and non-resident persons making distance or electronic supplies into Egypt must register irrespective of the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Closed-loop e-invoicing is mandatory. Every B2B invoice must be issued as an XML e-invoice through the ETA e-invoicing API in near real time, digitally signed and carrying a QR code. The ETA automatically validates each invoice against XML schemas, taxpayer registration status, and the reusable unique invoice identifier, and returns Accepted or Rejected status; only accepted invoices confer input VAT deduction rights on the buyer. E-receipts are mandatory for B2C sales. Invoices not transmitted through the ETA e-invoicing channel are treated as not issued for VAT deduction purposes, and no alternative paper-invoice channel exists.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of craft beer and kegs by the registered EG_LLC are zero-rated at 0% VAT where: (i) the exporter holds valid VAT registration and the alcohol export license; (ii) the goods physically leave Egypt under the customs export declaration within the time limit accepted by the ETA; (iii) the export invoice and e-invoice identify the foreign buyer, state the 0% rate, and do not charge domestic VAT; (iv) the goods are exported for valuable consideration in foreign currency; and (v) the foreign-currency proceeds are received into an Egyptian authorized bank account. Corresponding input VAT on kegs, cold-chain logistics, malt, hops, and distribution overhead is creditable and refundable through the ETA export refund cycle once the export documentation is matched. Offshore services supplied to non-residents may equally be zero-rated where the supply is outside Egypt under the place-of-supply rules.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA export-refund and audit directorates cross-check every zero-rating claim against the ASYCUDA World customs database, shipping manifests, inward remittance certificates issued by authorized Egyptian banks, and the accepted e-invoice archive. Where the goods did not leave Egypt, the declared value is inflated, or the export proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days, the transaction is re-characterized as a domestic supply: 14% VAT is assessed on the contract value, the input VAT previously refunded is clawed back, and a monthly late-payment surcharge runs from the original refund date. Administrative evasion penalties apply at statutory percentages of the tax evaded, with discretionary fines scaled by gravity; forged customs or bank certificates expose the entity and its managers to criminal prosecution, and repeated violations trigger suspension of VAT registration and forfeiture of export zero-rating privileges for a period set by the ETA.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — Banking Supervision and Foreign Exchange Control Departments under Law No. 194 of 2020, as applied together with Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and the CBE's successive exchange-control circulars.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed-float regime and maintains current-account convertibility. Routine current payments, trade flows, and distributions may be effected through CBE-licensed banks without a general prior no-objection, provided the underlying transaction is supported by standard commercial documents. Capital-account inflows, including direct equity contributions by non-resident shareholders, require GAFI registration and bank-level verification; profit remittances are permitted after certification of distributable reserves by the statutory auditor, a valid tax clearance, an updated commercial registration, and a board resolution. In practice, CBE-designated banks apply a documentary gate rather than discretionary rationing, but funds for transactions with sanctions-related counterparties or insufficient import/export documentation are routinely rejected.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE instructions, the full invoice value of exported goods must be repatriated to Egypt through a licensed bank within the statutory window, commonly four months from the date of shipment, or such extended period as the CBE approves on a case-by-case basis. There is no mandatory conversion/surrender of export receipts into Egyptian pounds: proceeds may be retained in a foreign-currency account of the exporting LLC at an Egyptian bank. Any exception permitting disposal or retention of export proceeds abroad prior to repatriation requires a written CBE authorization. For craft-beer export transactions, the bank will require the relevant customs export declaration, the sales contract, and a delivery/pro-forma invoice to confirm the foreign-currency receivable before clearing.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with Treasury and FX Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs and e-money platforms are not licensed by the CBE to hold EGP deposits, operate domestic IBANs, or execute onshore FX settlement; they therefore cannot be used as primary treasury rails for an Egyptian operating LLC. Restricted use is feasible only as an auxiliary payment interface for small-volume commercial cards or foreign-currency procurement, with the underlying clearing always performed by a CBE-licensed correspondent bank. The compliance burden is disproportionate to the utility, and the decision is therefore disfavored for the fully regulated treasury objective.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for the resident general manager and at least one locally registered director of the Egyptian LLC during initial account activation. Fully remote opening is not available under CBE bank KYC policies for a newly formed LLC with non-resident ownership. Non-resident shareholders may execute notarized powers of attorney and submit certified passport copies, but the Brazilian-style remote digital interview generally supplements rather than replaces the in-bank onboarding session. Documents executed abroad must be authenticated by the Egyptian consulate in the country of execution and, where requested, countersigned by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs because Egypt does not presently arrange apostille-style recognition with all cross-border counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders and ultimate beneficial ownership opacity for a new distribution LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, GAFI registration certificate, shareholder register, UBO attestation, passport copies of all directors/UBOs, certified board resolutions appointing resident signatories, power-of-attorney deeds, bank references, and prior-year audited financial statements where available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Alcohol-sector licensing and import/export of beverage alcohol where the nature of the products may raise reputational concern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial register listing beverage wholesale and distribution, GOEIC import/export credentials, valid alcoholic-beverage trade permit issued by the relevant supply authority, product-liability insurance policies, port-authority and customs records, and a detailed compliance memorandum demonstrating compliance with Egyptian food-safety and alcohol-advertising restrictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: CFT/sanctions screening and correspondent-bank heightened scrutiny due to cross-border cash-equivalent movements and payment routing through multiple intermediaries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete list of expected counterparties and geographies, real supply contracts, custom declarations, transport and warehouse documentation, anti-bribery and anti-money-laundering manual, transaction-monitoring procedure, and an undertaking to provide invoice-by-invoice reconciliation for every outward wire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential source-of-funds insufficiency where initial share capital is funded by foreign personal wealth rather than clear operating cash flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent bank reference, source-of-wealth statement, professional valuation of any in-kind contributions, shareholder tax filings, dividend/interest evidence of accumulative income, and a signed declaration of absence of third-party funding or undisclosed beneficial ownership.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections from non-resident sponsors are wired in USD, EUR, or GBP to the Egyptian LLC's CBE-licensed bank account under the payment narrative 'Foreign Direct Investment – Share Capital / Shareholder Loan'. The corporate account must be pre-verified by the bank against the GAFI certificate, the LLC registration, and the board resolution authorizing the capital increase. The remitting bank will apply a capital-account purpose code; the receiving Egyptian bank will issue a capital inflow certificate / bank receipt for use in statutory audits, tax reporting, and profit repatriation calculations. Pass-through through third-country EMIs or intermediary wallets must be avoided; all funds must land in the onshore account of the named Egyptian entity. The usual clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 with rigorous matching of the beneficiary ID and collection of a unique CBE-level transaction code.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for hops, malt, kegs, cold-chain equipment, and distribution-related services are made primarily by SWIFT MT103 wires or MT202 cover payments for operational invoices, and by commercial letters of credit via SWIFT MT700 for larger capital purchases. The local clearing leg for domestic distributor collections is handled through the CBE retail/clearing system or normal local credit transfers under the Egyptian E-Invoice and Unified Banking Data repository frameworks. The bank will require every outward payment to match an underlying invoice and, where applicable, a customs declaration; payments to jurisdictionally non-compliant or sanctions-listed counterparties cannot be cleared.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward (USD/EUR versus EGP) executed with a CBE-licensed commercial bank against documented trade exposure.
FX swap with a CBE-licensed bank to cover dual-currency collection/payment timing mismatches.
Cross-currency interest-rate swap covering medium-term foreign-currency financing for warehouse and cold-chain capital expenditures.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) limited to the parent-level treasury overlay where no deliverable onshore EGP settlement is contemplated; onshore NDFs are not regarded as a standard permissible instrument in the domestic Egyptian banking market.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Tax Return (Form No. 1) and Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four (4) months after the fiscal year end; due 30 April for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 2% of tax due per month (Law No. 91/2005); late-payment interest at CBE prime rate plus statutory margin; enforced collection and lien on assets upon persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements filed with GAFI and Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI); Commercial Registry Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six (6) months of fiscal year end, following approval of the shareholders' meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Companies Law No. 159/1981 for non-filing; administrative strike-off risk for continued default; directors may incur personal liability for unpaid statutory obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Annual Renewal and Annual Guarantee Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office / GAFI central registration units
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due in January of each calendar year for the preceding registration year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge and suspension of the commercial registration certificate; restriction of lawful trading activities until renewal is completed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Confirmation Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Unit (ECOFI) via Commercial Registry / GAFI disclosure channel
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Update within thirty (30) days of any shareholding or control change; annual reconfirmation alongside the audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 1,000,000 under AML Law No. 83/2019 for inaccurate or incomplete UBO records; criminal liability for knowingly false declarations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Trade License (Rukhsa) and Alcoholic Beverage Distribution Sector Permit Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Governorate Municipality / Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade with sector-specific beverage licensing authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual unified local trade license renewal due by 31 January each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily fines for unlicensed operation, license suspension, closure of commercial premises, and potential revocation of the alcoholic beverage distribution permit

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs must appoint at least one accredited auditor and file audited annual financial statements irrespective of size or turnover (Companies Law No. 159/1981); the craft beer distribution entity is unconditionally subject to statutory audit owing to licensing and excise-regulated operations
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially converged with IFRS; EAS 1 for presentation of financial statements and specialized disclosure for excise and beverage-sector licensing

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must identify any natural person holding 25% or more of ownership or control, record UBO data within 30 days of any share transfer, and reconfirm the UBO register annually at the ordinary shareholders' meeting alongside audited financial statements; the current register must be made available to AML supervisory authorities upon request
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Contracts and Related-Party Transactions
